dedupe_keys.name: isdata industrial symbiosis data repository of case studies classification tools and material data

description: The Industrial Symbiosis Data Repository (ISDATA) is an open platform for collecting and supplying structured information on industrial symbiosis, the exchange of by-products, energy and resources between companies, and on eco-industrial parks. Its main efforts, as listed on the home page, are collecting case studies of industrial symbiosis and eco-industrial parks, making it easier to work with classification systems for materials and industries, mapping and integrating databases so that datasets can be linked, and recording material properties so that technologies applied to one material can be transferred to similar ones. It is meant to be used with other open or proprietary datasets, and provides tools for value chain actors, external facilitators and researchers, for example for symbiosis input-output matching websites. Coverage: global case studies as contributed; their number was not read. Format and access: a web platform with case studies and tools; free. Licence: not read. Caveats: only the home page was read; how current the repository is and how data can be exported were not checked. Simulation uses: documented material and energy exchanges between plants for modelling industrial interdependencies and the knock-on effects of a plant outage. Related records: the SYMBA industrial symbiosis solutions database (data-symba-industrial-symbiosis-solutions-database) and the library of industrial symbiosis case studies (data-library-industrial-symbiosis-case-studies) hold similar case data.
